# Saugeen Shores Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Port Elgin. Gas fireplace installation covers selecting and installing direct-vent fireplaces or freestanding gas stoves, including gas-line and venting requirements.

Email: contact@saugeenshoresheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://saugeenshoresheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Port Elgin, Southampton, Kincardine, Port Clark. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
